topics.name: The Names of God
topics.blurb: 74 names and titles of God in scripture, from Elohim and El Elyon to Abba, and what each one reveals about Him.

names.group: God the Creator and Most High

items.name: Elohim
items.about: God, the mighty Creator who made the heavens and the earth.

items.name: El Elyon
items.about: God Most High, above every power, possessor of heaven and earth. This collection is named for Him.

items.name: El Shaddai
items.about: God Almighty, all-powerful and all-sufficient for every need.

items.name: El Olam
items.about: The Everlasting God, without beginning or end.

items.name: El Roi
items.about: The God who sees me, who notices the overlooked and the hurting.

items.name: El Gibbor
items.about: Mighty God, strong to save.

items.name: El Chai
items.about: The Living God, active and present, unlike lifeless idols.

items.name: El Haggadol
items.about: The great God, mighty and awesome, who shows no partiality.

items.name: El Hakavod
items.about: The God of glory, whose voice thunders over the waters.

items.name: El De'ot
items.about: The God of knowledge, who knows all things and weighs every action.

items.name: Elohei Marom
items.about: God on high, exalted above the heavens.

items.name: Elohei Mikkarov
items.about: God who is near, not a God far off.

items.name: Elohei Kol Basar
items.about: God of all flesh, for whom nothing is too hard.

items.name: Attiq Yomin
items.about: The Ancient of Days, eternal Judge seated on His throne.

items.name: Shophet Kol Ha'aretz
items.about: Judge of all the earth, who always does what is right.

items.name: Melech HaKavod
items.about: The King of glory, strong and mighty.

items.name: YHWH
items.about: The LORD, the personal, covenant name of God: He who is, and keeps His promises.

items.name: Ehyeh Asher Ehyeh
items.about: I AM THAT I AM: the self-existent One who depends on nothing.

items.name: Adonai
items.about: Lord and Master, the rightful owner and ruler of all.

items.name: YHWH Jireh
items.about: The LORD will provide, who sees ahead and supplies what is needed.

items.name: YHWH Rapha
items.about: The LORD who heals, body and soul.

items.name: YHWH Nissi
items.about: The LORD my banner, under whom His people stand and win.

items.name: YHWH Mekoddishkem
items.about: The LORD who sanctifies you, who makes His people holy.

items.name: YHWH Shalom
items.about: The LORD is peace, wholeness and rest.

items.name: YHWH Tsebaoth
items.about: The LORD of hosts, commander of heaven's armies.

items.name: YHWH Rohi
items.about: The LORD my shepherd, who leads, feeds and protects.

items.name: YHWH Tsidkenu
items.about: The LORD our righteousness, who makes us right with Him.

items.name: YHWH Shammah
items.about: The LORD is there, present with His people.

items.name: YHWH Elyon
items.about: The LORD Most High, worthy of praise.

items.name: YHWH Hoseenu
items.about: The LORD our Maker, before whom we kneel.

items.name: YHWH Gibbor Milchamah
items.about: The LORD mighty in battle, who fights for His people.

items.name: YHWH Go'el
items.about: The LORD your Redeemer, who buys back and sets free.

items.name: El Emunah
items.about: The faithful God, who keeps covenant and mercy for a thousand generations.

items.name: El Rachum
items.about: The merciful God, who will not forsake His people.

items.name: El Nose
items.about: The God who forgives, who carries away sin.

items.name: El Kanna
items.about: The jealous God, whose love will not share His people with idols.

items.name: Elohim Kedoshim
items.about: The holy God, set apart and pure.

items.name: Elohei Tzidki
items.about: God of my righteousness, who hears and vindicates.

items.name: Elohei Mishpat
items.about: The God of justice, who waits to be gracious.

items.name: Elohei Chasdi
items.about: The God of my mercy, whose kindness goes before me.

items.name: Kedosh Yisrael
items.about: The Holy One of Israel, who helps and redeems.

items.name: Avir Yaakov
items.about: The Mighty One of Jacob, Savior and Redeemer.

items.name: Avinu
items.about: Our Father, who formed us as a potter shapes clay.

items.name: Yotser
items.about: The Potter, who shapes and reshapes His people.

items.name: El Yeshuati
items.about: God of my salvation, my strength and my song.

items.name: El Sali
items.about: God my rock, when I feel forgotten.

items.name: Elohei Ma'uzzi
items.about: God my strength, my stronghold.

items.name: YHWH Tsuri
items.about: The LORD my rock, fortress and deliverer.

items.name: YHWH Misgabbi
items.about: The LORD my high tower, a safe place above danger.

items.name: YHWH Magen
items.about: The LORD my shield, the lifter of my head.

items.name: YHWH Ezer
items.about: The LORD my help, maker of heaven and earth.

items.name: YHWH Uzzi
items.about: The LORD my strength, in whom my heart trusts.

items.name: YHWH Ori
items.about: The LORD my light, so whom shall I fear?

items.name: YHWH Machsi
items.about: The LORD my refuge, my dwelling place of safety.

items.name: Ma'on
items.about: Our dwelling place, our home in every generation.

items.name: Tzur Olamim
items.about: The Rock of Ages, everlasting strength.

items.name: Immanuel
items.about: God with us.

items.name: Yeshua
items.about: Jesus: the LORD saves, who saves His people from their sins.

items.name: Mashiach
items.about: Messiah, the Christ: the Anointed One.

items.name: Sar Shalom
items.about: Prince of Peace, Wonderful Counsellor, Everlasting Father.

items.name: The Word (Logos)
items.about: The Word who was with God and was God, through whom all things were made.

items.name: Lamb of God
items.about: Who takes away the sin of the world.

items.name: The Good Shepherd
items.about: Who lays down His life for the sheep.

items.name: Bread of Life
items.about: Who satisfies the deepest hunger.

items.name: Light of the World
items.about: Whoever follows Him will not walk in darkness.

items.name: The Resurrection and the Life
items.about: In whom death does not have the last word.

items.name: The Way, the Truth, and the Life
items.about: The way to the Father.

items.name: Alpha and Omega
items.about: The beginning and the end, who is, who was and who is to come.

items.name: Lion of the Tribe of Judah
items.about: The Root of David, who has overcome.

items.name: King of Kings and Lord of Lords
items.about: Ruler over every ruler.

names.group: The Spirit and the Father's Heart

items.name: Abba
items.about: Father: the close, trusting name the Spirit teaches God's children to cry.

items.name: Ruach Elohim
items.about: The Spirit of God, moving over creation.

items.name: The Comforter (Paraclete)
items.about: The Holy Spirit, who teaches and brings to remembrance.

items.name: The Spirit of Truth
items.about: Who guides into all truth.
